digest.component_or_area: plan clarity and P1 readiness gates
propositions: Standalone clarity and P1 readiness must enforce a deterministic structural floor that rejects empty parsed Acceptance Criteria checklist items and unresolved sentinel assignments in active execution sections.

The shared plan-structure helper recognizes standard `- [ ]` and `- [x]` checklist items within the exact Acceptance Criteria section and marks items defective only when the fully joined body is whitespace-empty.

Sentinel tokens (TBD, TODO, FIXME, ???) in active sections fail only when they start a line or bullet, follow `:` or `=`, or follow is/remains/left, and are suppressed by same-line negation terms (no, zero, remove, delete, reject, forbid, must not, without).
Fenced code blocks and inline backtick code do not trigger the sentinel or empty-item rules.
The shared result is wired into both standalone `clarity_check_compute` and plan-review `p1_readiness_shape` while preserving existing clarity score as compatibility coverage.
Focused unit tests verify all acceptance criteria, direct-consumer regression tests pass, and the full repository test suite (7305 tests) passes with zero failures.
